description: This file implements SPI driver functions for the PSoC6 platform in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, transfer management, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_transfer_next_packet
methods.description: Prepares and initiates the next SPI transfer packet based on remaining data length.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling SPI transfer completion and starting the next packet.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_get_freqdiv
methods.description: Calculates the oversampling rate for a given SPI frequency.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_master_get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration parameters for SPI master mode.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_configure
methods.description: Configures the SPI device with specified settings, including mode, data width, and clock.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_transceive_sync_loop
methods.description: Performs synchronous SPI data transfer in a loop until all data is transferred.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_transceive
methods.description: Main function to handle SPI transceive operation, supporting sync and async modes.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_release
methods.description: Releases the SPI device, unlocking the context.

methods.name: spi_psoc6_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI device, configures GPIOs, clocks, and device context.
